12.t: Working with data: gold and its alloys
q: What percentage of 18-carat gold is gold?
Describe the relationship between % gold and hardness.
Less gold (more other metals), harder alloy.
Other metal atoms of different sizes disrupt the layers of gold atoms so they cannot slide.
Predict the hardness of 9-carat gold and suggest one disadvantage of using it.
About 150 to 200: harder still. Disadvantage: less gold, so less valuable, and other metals may tarnish.
